title: 第二十一章 突破第二十二章 刀疤脸老六
slug: 武道每日加点打更人肝成人间武圣
content_zh:
秦苏回到家，关好院门，插好门栓，把怀里的药膳包放在桌上，先喝了几口冷水，压下胸口翻涌的气血。
夜色如墨，只有屋里的油灯透出来一点昏黄的光。
秦苏没有休息很长时间，就走到了院子中央，深吸一口气，拉开了五行归元桩。
脚下扎稳马步，气息缓缓沉入丹田，桩功一起，筋骨瞬间舒展，一遍又一遍，循环往复。
一个时辰转瞬即逝，秦苏边练边看向自己脑海中的系统面板，五行归元桩的数值从97跳到了98。
这个积累的速度，比起最开始要快得多。
最开始入武馆时，他练一整天，五行归元桩熟练度才涨一点。
后来根骨和悟性提升，半天就能涨一点。
如今桩功临近大成，不过一个时辰，就涨了一点。
悟性与根骨的提升，让他对桩功的理解愈发通透，每一遍练下来，都有新的理解，不像最开始那样滞涩。
他歇了不到半盏茶的功夫，再次拉开架势，继续站桩。
夜色越来越深，巷子里的打更声敲了两回。
秦苏依旧站在院子里，桩功一遍接一遍。
不知道练了几遍，也不知道过去了多久，他只觉得体内的气血越来越顺。
当最后一遍桩功收势，一股暖流从脚底窜起，顺着脊椎直冲头顶，又顺着四肢百骸淌遍全身。
气血充盈，每一寸筋骨都像是被温水泡过，舒展到了极致。
秦苏只觉得身体前所未有的强大，情不自禁地就一拳砸向了还未劈开的柴火。
“咚”的一声闷响，碗口粗的木柴应声而断。
秦苏凝神看向面板。
【姓名：秦苏】

【境界：凡人】
【根骨：41】
【悟性：29】
【功法：五行归元桩：100500（大成）、开山拳：1820（未入门）】
【天赋点：0】
五行归元桩大成，秦苏顺利扣关，踏入明劲。
历时五十天，秦苏从一名普通人成为了一名真正的武者！
入门时只是力从地起，筋骨通顺，如今却是气血沉于脏腑，劲达四肢末梢，周身筋骨浑然一体。
一拳一脚，都能将全身的力道拧成一股，尽数打出去。
这就是明劲武者的标志，也是凡人与武者之间，最难以逾越的鸿沟。
秦苏站在院子里，夜风卷着寒意吹过来，他却不觉得冷。
content_en:
Qin Su returned home, closed the courtyard door, bolted the door, put the medicinal meal package in his arms on the table, and drank a few sips of cold water to suppress the surging blood in his chest.
The night was dark, with only a dim light coming from the oil lamp in the house.
Qin Su didn't rest for a long time, so he walked to the center of the yard, took a deep breath, and opened the Five Elements Guiyuan Stake.
Keeping your feet steady, your breath slowly sinks into your Dantian, and together with the posture exercises, your muscles and bones instantly stretch, over and over again, in a cycle.
An hour passed quickly. Qin Su looked at the system panel in his mind while practicing. The value of the Five Elements Guiyuan Pile jumped from 97 to 98.
This accumulation speed is much faster than at the beginning.
When he first entered the martial arts gym, he practiced all day long, and his proficiency in the Five Elements Guiyuan Zhuang only improved a little.
Later, as the foundation and understanding improved, it would rise a little in half a day.
Now the pile skill is close to completion, but within an hour, it has increased a little.
The improvement of his understanding and basic skills allowed him to understand Zhuang Gong more clearly. Every time he practiced it, he had a new understanding, which was not as stagnant as at the beginning.
After resting for less than half a cup of tea, he regained his posture and continued to stand.
The night was getting darker and darker, and there was a knocking sound in the alley twice.
Qin Su was still standing in the yard, performing the Zhuang Kung Fu over and over again.
He didn't know how many times he had practiced, and he didn't know how long it had been. He just felt that the energy and blood in his body were getting smoother and smoother.
When the last exercise of Zhuang Gong was completed, a warm current sprang up from the soles of the feet, rushed along the spine to the top of the head, and then flowed along the limbs and bones throughout the body.
The energy and blood are full, and every inch of the muscles and bones feel as if they have been soaked in warm water and stretched to the extreme.
Qin Su felt that his body was stronger than ever before, and he couldn't help but punch the firewood that had not been split.
There was a muffled "dong" sound, and the thick wood in the bowl broke.
Qin Su looked at the panel intently.
[Name: Qin Su]
[Realm: Mortal]
【Root bone: 41】
【Comprehension: 29】
[Kung Fu: Five Elements Gui Yuan Zhuang: 100500 (Dacheng), Kaishan Quan: 1820 (Not yet started)]
[Talent points: 0]
The Five Elements Return to Yuan Zhuang was completed, and Qin Su successfully passed the check and stepped into Ming Jin.
In fifty days, Qin Su transformed from an ordinary person to a true warrior!
At the beginning, the strength was just rising from the ground, and the muscles and bones were smooth. But now, the energy and blood are sinking in the organs, the strength reaches the ends of the limbs, and the muscles and bones of the whole body are integrated.
With a punch or a kick, all the strength in the body can be twisted into one force and punched out.
This is the mark of a Ming Jin warrior, and it is also the most insurmountable gap between mortals and warriors.
Qin Su stood in the yard. The night wind brought a chill, but he didn't feel cold.
